quests.instruction: Which family member is a sister who is behind you in age, though not necessarily by many years?
quests.hint: Even a single year makes her younger than you.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister is a sister who is behind you in age, whether by many years or just one.
quests.funFact: Siblings close in age sometimes end up in the same classes or activities growing up!

quests.instruction: Which family member reaches each school milestone, like starting kindergarten, after you did, and is a boy?
quests.hint: He has not yet experienced being your current age.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother reaches each school milestone after you did, since he was born later.
quests.funFact: A person can be an older sibling to one brother or sister and a younger sibling to another, all at once!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a brother who is ahead of you in age, though not necessarily by many years?
quests.hint: Even a single year makes him older than you.
quests.explanation: Older Brother is a brother who is ahead of you in age, whether by many years or just one.
quests.funFact: The age gap between siblings can range from under a year to many years!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man even older than your grandfather, from an earlier generation?
quests.hint: He belongs to the generation right before your grandparents.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is a man even older than your grandfather, from an earlier generation.
quests.funFact: A family photo with four generations together, including a great-grandfather, is a rare and special treasure!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a sister who was born before you?
quests.hint: She has lived a few more years than you have.
quests.explanation: Older Sister is a sister who was born before you.
quests.funFact: In many families, the oldest child is given a few extra responsibilities as they grow up.

quests.instruction: Which family member might you look out for as your little sister?
quests.hint: She is a sister with fewer years of life experience than you.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister might be someone you look out for as your little sister.
quests.funFact: Being a big sibling often means learning patience while a younger sibling catches up!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you sometimes look out for the way a big sibling does, and is a boy?
quests.hint: He joined the family a little later than you.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother might be someone you sometimes look out for the way a big sibling does.
quests.funFact: No matter the age gap, siblings often share family traits like laughs, hobbies, or favorite foods.

quests.instruction: Which family member might you look up to as your big brother?
quests.hint: He is a brother with more years of life experience than you.
quests.explanation: Older Brother might be someone you look up to as your big brother.
quests.funFact: Many younger siblings say they loved copying their older brother's favorite games!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a man from a generation even before your grandparents' own childhood?
quests.hint: He is your grandfather's own father, or your grandmother's own father.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is a man from a generation even before your grandparents' own childhood.
quests.funFact: Learning about a great-grandfather is a wonderful way to connect with your family's deeper history!

quests.instruction: Which family member might have hand-me-down clothes or toys passed down to you, and is a girl?
quests.hint: She used these things herself first, being born earlier.
quests.explanation: Older Sister might have hand-me-down clothes or toys passed down to you, since she used them first.
quests.funFact: An age gap of just one or two years often means siblings grow up doing lots of activities together.

quests.instruction: Which family member is your sister who has not yet experienced being exactly your current age?
quests.hint: Since she is younger, she has not reached your current age yet.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister is your sister who has not yet experienced being exactly your current age.
quests.funFact: Some younger siblings say their older sibling helped them feel brave on their first day of school!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a brother who is behind you in age, though not necessarily by many years?
quests.hint: Even a single year makes him younger than you.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother is a brother who is behind you in age, whether by many years or just one.
quests.funFact: Families with many children often have a whole line of siblings, from oldest all the way to youngest.

quests.instruction: Which family member is a brother who was born before you?
quests.hint: He has lived a few more years than you have.
quests.explanation: Older Brother is a brother who was born before you.
quests.funFact: Being called 'big brother' is a title that lasts a lifetime, no matter how old you both get!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the oldest man in your close family, from an early generation?
quests.hint: He raised your own grandmother or grandfather.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is often the oldest man in your close family, from an early generation.
quests.funFact: A great-grandfather has often lived through many decades of changes in the world!

quests.instruction: Which family member's birthday falls in an earlier year than yours, among your own sisters?
quests.hint: She was born in a year before your own birth year.
quests.explanation: Older Sister's birthday falls in an earlier year than yours, among your own sisters.
quests.funFact: Some researchers study whether birth order shapes parts of a person's personality, though every child is unique.

quests.instruction: Which family member is a sister who was born after you?
quests.hint: She has lived fewer years than you have.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister is a sister who was born after you.
quests.funFact: Being the 'baby' of the family sometimes means getting a little extra attention while growing up!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a boy sibling who started school after you did?
quests.hint: He reached this school milestone later because he is younger.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother is a boy sibling who started school after you did, since he is younger.
quests.funFact: A younger sibling sometimes becomes the one who remembers the silliest family stories best.

quests.instruction: Which family member might sometimes look out for you the way a big sibling does, and is a boy?
quests.hint: He has been part of the family a little longer than you.
quests.explanation: Older Brother might sometimes look out for you the way a big sibling does.
quests.funFact: Older siblings often remember teaching a younger sibling to ride a bike or tie their shoes!

quests.instruction: Which family member is the father of one of your four grandparents?
quests.hint: He is three generations above you.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather is the father of one of your four grandparents.
quests.funFact: Since you can have up to four grandparents, you can also have up to four great-grandfathers!

quests.instruction: Which family member reached each school milestone, like starting kindergarten, before you did, and is a girl?
quests.hint: She has already experienced being your current age.
quests.explanation: Older Sister reached each school milestone before you did, since she was born earlier.
quests.funFact: The order in which children are born in a family is sometimes called 'birth order.'

quests.instruction: Which family member's birthday falls in a later year than yours, among your own sisters?
quests.hint: She was born in a year after your own birth year.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister's birthday falls in a later year than yours, among your own sisters.
quests.funFact: Family photos often line children up from oldest to youngest, tallest to shortest!

quests.instruction: Which family member is your brother who has not yet experienced being exactly your current age?
quests.hint: Since he is younger, he has not reached your current age yet.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother is your brother who has not yet experienced being exactly your current age.
quests.funFact: Growing up with a younger sibling often means always having a built-in friend close by.

quests.instruction: Which family member's birthday falls in an earlier year than yours, among your own brothers?
quests.hint: He was born in a year before your own birth year.
quests.explanation: Older Brother's birthday falls in an earlier year than yours, among your own brothers.
quests.funFact: In large families, birth order can range all the way from the oldest child down to the youngest!

quests.instruction: Which family member might your own grandfather call 'Dad'?
quests.hint: He is your grandfather's own father.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather might be called 'Dad' by your own grandfather, since he is his father.
quests.funFact: Even a grandfather was once a small boy being raised by his very own father!

quests.instruction: Which family member might you look up to as your big sister?
quests.hint: She is a sister with more years of life experience than you.
quests.explanation: Older Sister might be someone you look up to as your big sister.
quests.funFact: Older siblings sometimes remember details about family life that younger siblings never got to see.

quests.instruction: Which family member might receive your old hand-me-down clothes or toys, and is a girl?
quests.hint: She would use these things after you, being born later.
quests.explanation: Younger Sister might receive your old hand-me-down clothes or toys, since she comes after you.
quests.funFact: Younger siblings often get to benefit from lessons their older sibling already learned!

quests.instruction: Which family member might receive your old hand-me-down clothes or toys, and is a boy?
quests.hint: He would use these things after you, being born later.
quests.explanation: Younger Brother might receive your old hand-me-down clothes or toys, since he comes after you.
quests.funFact: Older siblings sometimes get to pick a nickname for a new baby brother or sister.

quests.instruction: Which family member might have hand-me-down clothes or toys passed down to you, and is a boy?
quests.hint: He used these things himself first, being born earlier.
quests.explanation: Older Brother might have hand-me-down clothes or toys passed down to you, since he used them first.
quests.funFact: In many families, clothes and toys get happily passed down from an older sibling to a younger one!

quests.instruction: Which family member has often seen the most changes in the world across his lifetime, among your male relatives?
quests.hint: He belongs to the very oldest generation you might know.
quests.explanation: Great-Grandfather has often seen the most changes in the world, since he belongs to the oldest generation.
quests.funFact: Some great-grandfathers can share memories from many decades before you were even born!

quests.instruction: Which family member is a girl sibling who has more years of life experience than you?
quests.hint: She was born before you, so she has lived longer.
quests.explanation: Older Sister is a girl sibling who has more years of life experience than you.
quests.funFact: Many people say their relationship with a sibling changes and grows as they both get older.
